text:
amal: Postmortem follow-up: three recurring signals still present — dropped trace headers causing missing spans, ETL replays causing aggregation inflation, and sporadic lag tied to checkpoint GC. Need owners, short timelines, a conservative backfill.
jorge: I can own the header propagation fix in the edge and SDK. Plan: add header assertion in the proxy + a CI test that asserts X-Trace-ID roundtrip. ETA 48h, 24h canary. Rollback: disable header enforcement flag. Blocker: confirmation from CDN team.
gita: I'll take ETL checkpoint durability and a lightweight dedupe stage before rollups. Plan: write immutable checkpoint objects and add a seq_id monotonic check. ETA 3 business days. Backfill plan: targeted recompute for the affected 3h window during low traffic. Rollback: restore rollup snapshot. Blocker: need replica slot/time window.
amal: Please paste a 1-line verification query and the small backfill SQL snippet for infra to review perms.
jorge: verification (bash):
```bash
curl -H "X-Trace-ID: tt-1" https://edge-test.redwood/api/health | grep tt-1 || exit 1
```
gita: backfill SQL (trimmed):
```sql
INSERT INTO rollup_staging (metric, window_start, value)
SELECT metric, window_start, SUM(value)
FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric, window_start ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn FROM raw_events WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-25T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-25T05:00:00Z') t WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY metric, window_start;
```
infra-bot: Postmortem doc published: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/203400 — owner reminders created. IAM note: ensure backfill role has snapshot and staging write perms.
amal: Success criteria suggestion: missing spans <0.05% within 24h of canary; rollup diffs <0.4% after backfill; ETL lag <90s steady. Flag if unrealistic.
jorge: OK with metrics. I'll ping @cdn-team now.
gita: I'll prepare runbook + dry-run plan and post it by EOD+2. Need the maintenance window; can ops hold 03:00-04:30 UTC?
oncall-bot: Calendar invite created for 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z - 03:45:00Z UTC for backfill. Reminder set for owners check-in.
amal: Deadlines: jorge header PR + CI by EOD+2; gita checkpoint + dedupe PR + runbook by EOD+3. If anything slips, update thread.
jorge: ack.
gita: ack.
amal: I'll consolidate into the postmortem doc and mark action items. We'll reconvene after the dry-run/canary. Keep updates short in-thread.
